notes: rule 11: a cited book («في العلل التي تروى عن الفضل بن شاذان») — a source known by its title, with its author as the first link; the route is the reading of the text, for the ruling
the hearing from al-Rida is only said («وَ يُذْكَرُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهَا مِنَ اَلرِّضَا»): al-Rida is written after «من», so narrator, not imam_in_text (rule 2)
